:::{#exm-profile-loglik}
#### Profile log-likelihood of a Gaussian variance

In the Gaussian model, $\hat\mu = \bar x$ maximizes $\ell$ over $\mu$
for every value of $\sigma^2$ (@sec-gaussian-mle),
so the profile log-likelihood of $\sigma^2$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}
\ell_p(\sigma^2)
&= \ell(\bar x, \sigma^2)
&& \text{(definition of the profile log-likelihood)}\\
&= -\frac{n}{2}\logf{2\pi} - \frac{n}{2}\logf{\sigma^2}
 - \frac{1}{2\sigma^2}\sumin (x_i - \bar x)^2
&& \text{(Gaussian log-likelihood at $\mu = \bar x$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
